verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only single-job operations: create a job from one URL or uploaded file, read one job's status, and cancel one job. There is no batch or bulk endpoint, and no multi-item action in the API or the MCP tools. Zapier and Google Drive automations run per file and are third-party workflows, not a bulk-operation capability of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
